title: Efficient and Debiased Learning of Average Hazard Under Non-Proportional Hazards
abstract: arXiv:2602.13475v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: The hazard ratio from the Cox proportional hazards model is a ubiquitous summary of treatment effect. However, when hazards are non-proportional, the hazard ratio can lose a stable causal interpretation and become study-dependent because it effectively averages time-varying effects with weights determined by follow-up and censoring. We consider the average hazard (AH) as an alternative causal estimand: a population-level person-time event rate that remains well-defined and interpretable without assuming proportional hazards. Although AH can be estimated nonparametrically and regression-style adjustments have been proposed, existing approaches do not provide a general framework for flexible, high-dimensional nuisance estimation with valid sqrt{n} inference. We address this gap by developing a semiparametric, doubly robust framework for covariate-adjusted AH. We establish pathwise differentiability of AH in the nonparametric mode

translated_title: 非比例风险下平均风险的高效且无偏学习
translated_abstract: Cox比例风险模型产生的风险比是汇总治疗效果的常用指标。然而，当风险非成比例时，风险比可能失去稳定的因果解释并变得依赖于具体研究，因为它实际上是用由随访时长和删失机制决定的权重来平均时变效应。我们考虑将平均风险（AH）作为替代的因果估计量：它是一个人群水平的人时事件率，在不假设比例风险的情况下仍然具有良好的定义和可解释性。尽管AH可以通过非参数方法进行估计，且已有回归式的调整方法被提出，但现有方法并未为灵活的高维冗余参数估计提供具有有效√n推断的通用框架。我们通过开发一个半参数、双重稳健的协变量调整AH框架来填补这一空白。我们在非参数模型中建立了AH的路径可微性……
tldr: 该论文提出一个半参数双重稳健框架，实现了非比例风险情形下协变量调整平均风险（AH）的高效估计与有效的√n推断，为比例风险假设不成立时的因果效应估计提供了可靠的替代方案。
